One or two sentences on what this release is for: the problem it answers, not
the list of commits. Leave it out when the release is a handful of fixes that
speak for themselves.

### Breaking

- What no longer works, and the line to change. Say whether there is an alias.

### Added

- The command or flag, then what it is for.

  ```sh
  monkeys poo @production --WITH_SECRETS
  ```

  A paragraph under the example when the reason is not obvious from it.

### Changed

- What behaves differently, and what it did before.

### Fixed

- The symptom first, then the cause. Someone reading this is checking whether
  the thing that bit them is the thing that was fixed.

### Documentation

- Pages worth a link.
